scope: Publicly discoverable official pages, publisher catalogues, library records, dissertations, and selected official media entry points relevant to Alexey Petrovich Sitnikov, hypnosis, self-hypnosis, NLP, coaching, reflection, and self-regulation.

completeness.statement: The official biography says Alexey Sitnikov is author or co-author of 14 monographs, but no single authoritative public bibliography enumerating all 14 was found. This registry does not claim to contain every article, social post, interview, video, edition, or co-authored work.
completeness.rule: Unverified attribution remains NEEDS_EVIDENCE. Dynamic channel counts and planned books are not treated as fixed bibliographic facts.

evidence_classes.OFFICIAL_AUTHOR: Official Sitnikov/Karmalogic website or official author channel.
evidence_classes.PUBLISHER: Publisher catalogue or official edition page.
evidence_classes.LIBRARY: National or institutional library bibliographic record.
evidence_classes.PROFESSIONAL_CLINICAL: Professional or public-health source used only for hypnosis safety/evidence boundaries.
evidence_classes.SECONDARY_DISCOVERY: Useful for discovery but insufficient alone for a strong attribution or efficacy claim.
